entries.text: A thief drops from the eaves of {name}, moonlight glinting on {its:feature}
Seen from the road: {name}, {f:condition}, doors wide, a loaded cart rattling off
One window of {name} glows as a lantern moves from room to room, far too fast for a guard
A rope hangs from a broken window of {name}, lit by {f:light}
Drow raiders lower stolen crates from {name} on ropes of spider silk, faerzress pulsing below
Black thorns climb {name} in a single night, strangling {its:feature}
Through the fog: {name}, {f:condition}, every window showing the same pale face
Close on the front door of {name}, its {f:material} weeping dark sap from every seam
The last villager backs away from {name} as its shadow stretches toward them, against the sun
Ghosts crowd every window of {name}, {f:condition}, faces pressed to the glass
A contract nailed to the door of {name} flutters in the wind, lit by {f:light}
A builder shakes a clawed hand at midnight as {name} rises around them, stone by stone
Close on a signature burned into the {f:material} above the door of {name}
A smiling figure waits at the gate of {name} with an open palm, lit by {f:light}
Chains of red iron stretch from {name} down into a crack of hellfire
The gates of {name} swing open from the inside, and a torchlit army pours through
{name} burns behind a lone rider, {its:feature} collapsing into the flames
Behind {name}, {f:condition}, a trusted steward signals the enemy with a lantern
Close on a key turning in the lock of {name}, the hand wearing the founder's own signet
Crows burst from the roof of {name} as its gates open to the enemy
Mist parts to reveal {name}, {f:condition}, as if it had never been gone
Roots have swallowed {name} whole; only {its:feature} still shows
An explorer's torch finds the doorway of {name}, its {f:material} furred with dust
{name} sinks into a sea of cloud, {its:feature} the last thing showing
Divers' lanterns sweep across {name} on the seabed, {its:feature} draped in kelp
Snow buries {name} to the eaves, only {its:feature} breaking the drifts
Every window of {name} blazes at once, {its:feature} shuddering into motion
{name} draws a breath, doors flexing, dust exhaling from every crack, lit by {f:light}
Tight on {name}'s doorstep of {f:material}, splitting around a slowly opening eye
Seen at dusk, {name}, {f:condition}, turns on its foundations to face the viewer
Runes race across the {f:material} of {name} as every book inside takes flight
Vines burst into blossom across {name} as its doors swing open by themselves
{name} stands between a fleeing crowd and the storm, {its:feature} braced
A burglar's lantern freezes at the threshold of {name} as its doors grind shut
Torches of a besieging army ring {name}, {f:condition}, which still holds
Wards flare along the {f:material} walls of {name} as something huge tests the gate
A colossal angel of light stands astride {name}, wings sheltering {its:feature}
Lava parts around {name} like a river around a stone
A comet hangs directly over {name}, its tail pointing down at {its:feature}
Pilgrims kneel in the mud before {name}, {f:condition}, waiting for its door to open
Above the door of {name}, a carving shows the building in flames, lit by {f:light}
At sunrise the shadow of {name} falls exactly across an ancient standing stone
A portal tears open above {name}, exactly where the seers of Sigil drew it
A great stag stands on the roof of {name} at dawn, antlers black against the sun
